title: JCGS attributed circular-boundary corrective readiness
purpose: Verify the exact seed-1 CUDA gather failure and its periodic-index correction before any third full training attempt.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-optimizer readiness over the attributed C01 batch and prior C01-C08 readiness population; no checkpoint, threshold, C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User delegated autonomous best-method choices and requested continuous execution without repeated approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed synchronous seed-1 CUDA attribution run.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.fit: No fit. Reconstruct one deterministic 128-row C01 failure batch and repeat prior readiness.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Replay the exact deterministic seed/epoch/world/batch/rotation that failed, then repeat the prior contract checks.

teacher.source: Sealed continuous exit bearing/width/profile plus local axis and global geometry.
teacher.use: One exact loss forward/backward and prior zero-training method checks; no identity.
teacher.valid_mask: Existing exact peak, width and global geometry masks.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid images only.

split.historical_pollution_audit: The attribution run supplies only failure location and batch identity; no checkpoint initializes the readiness model.

methods.main: Canonical periodic linear coordinates map the floating-point representation of the circular endpoint 180 back to bin 0 before any gather; finite bearings remain mandatory.
methods.baseline: The synchronous formal attribution reproduced one raw lower index 180 at global sequence 180664 and located the failure at phase-log-mass gather.
methods.fallback: If exact-batch CUDA forward/backward, finite gradients or any prior readiness check fails, stop JCGS before retraining.

acceptance.attribution: Uncorrected coordinate reproduces exactly one raw lower index 180 in the formal batch.
acceptance.periodic_semantics: Corrected coordinate maps that endpoint to 0; all corrected indices are 0..179 without clipping.
acceptance.cuda: Exact 128-row batch completes full JCGS loss forward/backward with finite gradients.
acceptance.regression: All unit and prior phase/gap/symmetry/readiness checks pass.

failure_policy: Fail closed. PASS authorizes only a new full from-scratch three-seed training run.
retention: Retain exact boundary summary, logs, prior readiness evidence, environment, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: One CUDA batch forward/backward plus CPU readiness
